title: Open Brass Pocket Watch
description: Original static low-poly open pocket watch with a thick closed-back brass case, true recessed ivory dial, sixty separate physical markers, two separated blue-steel hands and a supported spindle, faceted winding crown and a genuine open bow. The shallow thick cover is fixed at 112 degrees on three individually bored hinge sleeves and an embedded axle, with finite case and cover mounting tongues. The flat circular back provides a finite ground-contact patch; all mesh components connect to it. No separate stand or chain is included. Six flat solid PBR materials, no images or textures. Metres, native Z up, dial +Z, front -Y and origin at ground below case centre. One original reusable prop, distinct from the old open-frame pendulum clock and sundial. Static stylized visual only: no timekeeping, calibration, clockwork, water resistance, precious-metal value, wearability, moving-cover or safety claim.
